nodes.label: Dark map tiles (CARTO Dark Matter or darkened OSM)
nodes.norm_label: dark map tiles (carto dark matter or darkened osm)
nodes.rationale: CARTO Dark Matter now needs a free key, so when CARTO_KEY is empty OpenStreetMap tiles are darkened with the .osm-dark CSS filter to avoid any watermark.

nodes.label: Dock aria-current sync observer
nodes.rationale: Navigation code only toggles .active, so a MutationObserver mirrors it to aria-current for screen readers.

nodes.label: Floating glass dock nav
nodes.rationale: Replaces the sidebar and bottom bar with one floating glass pill that works at every width; it hides behind open modals (body:has(...) .dock) and in theater mode.

nodes.label: hearts() floating hearts effect
nodes.rationale: Spawns inline SVG hearts (Lucide heart path) instead of emoji so they match the icon set and tint via currentColor.

nodes.label: Icon refresher (refreshIcons + MutationObserver)
nodes.rationale: Lists, cards and modals are rendered later as innerHTML strings; a MutationObserver re-runs lucide.createIcons (rAF-coalesced) whenever new data-lucide placeholders appear, and fails silently if the CDN is blocked.

nodes.label: Mic/cam buttons drawn with CSS masks
nodes.norm_label: mic/cam buttons drawn with css masks

nodes.label: nav() section navigation
nodes.rationale: Toggles .active on both sections and every [data-s] control, so the dock buttons highlight without any extra wiring.

nodes.label: Spotlight-style movie search dropdown (.mv-suggestions)
nodes.rationale: Restyled the TMDB suggestions as a macOS Spotlight-like frosted panel with a springy spotIn entrance and a keyboard hint footer.

nodes.label: Apple-Pro liquid glass design system
nodes.rationale: Shared tokens --glass, --blur and --sh-glass give every card, dock, modal and dropdown the same translucent blurred-glass surface on a dark base.

nodes.label: Lucide icons (unpkg CDN)
nodes.rationale: Replaced emoji with Lucide SVG icons via <i data-lucide> placeholders for a consistent, tintable, professional look.

nodes.label: WebRTC Together module
nodes.rationale: Mic/cam button labels are rewritten with textContent by toggleMic/toggleCam and hangup, so the glyphs are drawn with CSS masks keyed on .active instead of relying on the text.

nodes.label: PWA install prompt and iOS fallback
nodes.norm_label: pwa install prompt and ios fallback

nodes.label: Dashboard weather widget (two cities)
nodes.rationale: Uses Open-Meteo because it is free and needs no API key; the cities are chosen in-app and kept on this device only.
